# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** 18 years old by the end of Volume 5  <sub>[v2 c26 P46](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0046), [v3 c1 P16](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0016)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P61](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0061), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v4 c1 P1](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0001), [v4 c4 P12](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0012)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Role:** Housewife and mother  <sub>[v4 c1 P1](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0001), [v4 c1 P6](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0006)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Di  <sub>[v1 c18 P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025), [v2 c13 P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Diana is described as a very pretty girl with rosy cheeks, dimples, and a merry expression. She has black eyes and sleek, glossy black hair that curls. She is plump and short in stature, growing somewhat matronly after her marriage.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v3 c33 P13](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0013), [v4 c1 P1](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0001), [v4 c1 P25](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0025)_

## Personality

Diana is good-tempered, friendly, and practical, though she lacks Anne's vivid imagination. She is deeply loyal, warm-hearted, and supportive toward those she loves. While sensible and down-to-earth, she enjoys fun, companionship, and innocent gossip. She is also conventional and occasionally timid regarding social expectations or scary situations.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027), [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c21 P17](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0017), [v2 c2 P9](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0009), [v3 c12 P59](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0059)_

## History

Diana Barry meets Anne Shirley shortly after Anne arrives at Green Gables, and the two quickly swear eternal friendship at Orchard Slope. Throughout their childhood, Diana participates in Anne's games, imaginations, and the Avonlea Story Club. Despite a temporary separation imposed by her strict mother after accidentally drinking Marilla's currant wine, their bond remains unbroken, particularly after Anne saves Diana's little sister Minnie May during a bout of croup. Diana attends Avonlea School with Anne, though she does not pursue higher education at Queen's Academy or Redmond College. In her late teens, she becomes engaged to Fred Wright of Avonlea. They are married in a grand ceremony at Orchard Slope where Anne serves as her bridesmaid. Diana settles with Fred on a farm in Avonlea and gives birth to a son, Fred Jr., followed later by a daughter named Small Anne Cordelia.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P25](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0025), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c16 P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042), [v1 c16 P48](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0048), [v1 c18 P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v2 c29 P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v3 c29 P1](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0001), [v3 c29 P12](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0012), [v3 c39 P41](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0041), [v4 c1 P1](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0001)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up at Orchard Slope in Avonlea as the daughter of George and Mrs. Barry  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014)</sub>
- Attended Avonlea School alongside Anne Shirley and other local children  <sub>[v1 c15 P3](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0003), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>
- Accidentally became intoxicated on currant wine at Green Gables when served it by mistake  <sub>[v1 c16 P45](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0045), [v1 c16 P48](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0048)</sub>

## Quotes

> I solemnly swear to be faithful to my bosom friend, Anne Shirley, as long as the sun and moon shall endure.  <sub>[v1 c12 P36](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0036)</sub>

> Indeed I will, and I’ll never have another bosom friend—I don’t want to have. I couldn’t love anybody as I love you.  <sub>[v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005)</sub>

> I’m so happy, but it does seem ridiculous to think of me being engaged.  <sub>[v2 c29 P16](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0016)</sub>

> We are not really parting, Anne. I’m not going far away. We’ll love each other just as much as ever.  <sub>[v4 c1 P3](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0003)</sub>

> Isn’t he perfectly beautiful?  <sub>[v3 c39 P43](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0043)</sub>
